exposure: Symptoms suggestive of cow's milk protein allergy (CMPA)
cohort: The study included 141 preterm infants (mean gestational age 31 weeks) who developed symptoms suggestive of CMPA during neonatal intensive care unit hospitalization in Northeastern Israel between June 2009 and June 2020.
finding: CMPA in preterm infants often resolves by 1 year (16% persistence) with only 1.5% persistence at 6 years, but 39% developed subsequent atopic conditions.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of subsequent atopic disease (HR 1.22, p = 0.009).
